# Hardi Jain

> SaaS product manager (B2C, B2B and AI products) and Chartered Accountant. Previously at PayU, JPMorgan Chase, KPMG, PwC and Kotak Bank. This is the personal portfolio of Hardi Jain, hardijain.com — distinct from other people who share the name Hardi Jain or Hardik Jain.

Hardi Jain came to product management through internal audit, statutory audit and automation, and reads a funnel and a ledger the same way: find where the numbers stop matching the evidence. At PayU he managed three products — Payment Links, Web Checkout and the SDK.

## Product case studies

- [Checkout conversion and bot detection](https://hardijain.com/product-stories/checkout-conversion-bot-detection): traced a checkout success-rate drop from 65% to 60% on a 10M-user platform to bot traffic, and recovered it to 67% with invisible detection instead of a CAPTCHA.
- [Down payment and EMI for high-value checkout](https://hardijain.com/product-stories/down-payment-emi-high-value-checkout)
- [Partial payments for school fee payment links](https://hardijain.com/product-stories/partial-payments-education-payment-links)
- [Cross-platform payment UX standardization](https://hardijain.com/product-stories/cross-platform-payment-ux-standardization)
- [Self-serve payment links for merchants](https://hardijain.com/product-stories/self-serve-payment-links-merchant-configuration)
- [Payment link access control for external sales agents](https://hardijain.com/product-stories/payment-links-access-governance)
- [Cross-squad delivery on a payments platform](https://hardijain.com/product-stories/cross-squad-execution-and-delivery)
- [All product case studies](https://hardijain.com/product-stories)
